Card Q&A.q: Do I trash 1 card in my hand for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect even if the target card isn't among the revealed cards?

Effect: [On Play] [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Belphemon] or [Gizmon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
Inherited Effect: [End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 1 card in your hand, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
